description: CL5 epic-completion attestation. Binds every milestone, handoff, source, M6, semantic-loop, backup, restore, WBC, import, smoke, receipt, and retirement evidence produced by the plan; records the exact North Star runtime binding, the single active target architecture, the bounded whole-cutover operator recovery procedure, and the unresolved operational facts. This handoff documents VERIFIED TOOLING AND BOUNDED RECOVERY; it does NOT assert that a live operator cutover executed. The live operator cutover is explicitly DEFERRED/PENDING under the active formal deferral CL1-DEFERRAL-m5-sprint-artifacts-unrecoverable (accepted_for_cl2=false).

bounded_operator_recovery_commands.rule: Recovery is allowed ONLY during the cutover window and operates on the COMPLETE cutover, never on individual consumption boundaries. On any failed integrity or smoke check: stop admission; preserve the failed append-only evidence; restore the verified pre-cutover bundle and the single prior runtime/config revision; rebuild projections; verify hashes and WBC receipts; record the failed cutover. Do NOT resume on a partially mixed state or declare convergence. A second cutover requires a new reviewed receipt against a corrected revision.

commands.action: Record the (failed or successful) cutover receipt and retirement proof

single_target_vs_live_cutover_statement.what_is_true: The CL5 plan produced the complete cutover TOOLING and EVIDENCE: a frozen content-hash-bound CutoverConfig, an exhaustive drain map, atomic quiesce/fence, content-addressed backup, four-gate restore, isolated-restore proof, content-addressed receipt, retirement inventory/proof, override dispatch on both paths, bridge-denial/clearance-propagation custody tests, the input-hash staleness wiring, and the recurrence migration. The single-target architecture is the one supported design and CL4_BRIDGE_MODE is declared false in code.

This handoff therefore attests lifecycle tooling/evidence completion and a bounded recovery path, NOT a live cutover result.
